steps.text: Let P be the fundamental parallelogram {s omega_1 + t omega_2 : s,t in [0,1]}.
P is compact and f is continuous, so |f| attains a maximum M on P by the extreme value theorem.
Any z in C is congruent modulo the period lattice to z_0 in P.
By periodicity f(z)=f(z_0), so the local bound on P extends globally to all of C.
A bounded entire function is constant by Liouville's theorem.
